title: Plugins
catalogUnreachable: Could not reach the plugin catalog.
siteCatalogUnreachable: Could not reach the download-site catalog.
siteInstalled: {name} installed — restart to start using it.
removeSiteMessage: The site is deleted from this install. Anything already downloaded from it stays in your library.
pluginUpdated: Updated {name} to v{version} — restart BackIssue to switch to it.
pluginInstalled: Installed {name} — restart BackIssue to activate it.
removePluginMessage: The plugin’s folder is deleted from disk. Restart BackIssue to finish removing it — its saved settings are kept in case you reinstall.
toggleFailed: Could not update the plugin — is the app running?
pendingNone: Changes saved — restart BackIssue to apply them. Plugins register routes, jobs and sources at boot.
pendingList: {list} — restart BackIssue to apply. Plugins load at boot, so nothing changes until then.
restarted: BackIssue restarted — plugin changes are live.
restartTimeout: The app has not come back yet — check the server, then reload this page.
tryDifferent: Try a different category or search term.
installHint: Install plugins from the catalog, or drop a folder with an index.js into plugins/ and restart.
sitesHint: Sites are where issues and chapters come from. Install one here, then switch it on in Settings → Sources.
needsFlaresolverr: Behind Cloudflare — set the FlareSolverr URL in Settings → Downloading.
needsBrowser: Needs the browser build of the app (the image tagged -browser) — the site checks for a real browser.
superseded: This is now a download site, and you already have it installed there. The plugin is not loaded — you can remove it.

updateAllDone.one: Updated {count} plugin — restart BackIssue to switch to it.
updateAllDone.other: Updated {count} plugins — restart BackIssue to switch to them.
